source.note: The later documentation-only handoff commit does not change this executable.

request.expires_at: Unix seconds, future and at most 24 hours

commands.forbidden: Do not include recovery, silently fall back to Queue, or launch/restart a session.

semantics.acknowledged_turn_id: Only a matching native acknowledgement proves acceptance.
semantics.duplicate_policy: Same UUID and immutable request returns the original receipt. Changed payload, mode or preconditions conflict. Dispatch intent is durable before native write. Unknown/accepted/rejected requests are never automatically redispatched.
semantics.restart_policy: A bound intent without dispatch can proceed once. A durable uncertain dispatch survives reopening and never replays.
semantics.cancellation: Only provably unsent pending local intents can be cancelled; accepted/uncertain steering returns STEERING_CANCELLATION_UNSUPPORTED.
semantics.observation: Target lookup is read-only, bounded to five seconds. Normal observations advertise actions.steer but do not reconstruct active turn IDs. Receipt polling is local and never borrows the active turn reply.
limitations: Acceptance does not imply immediate consumption or response.
No steer-specific reply/consumption evidence is exposed by the verified summary path.
Lost, malformed, mismatched acknowledgements and unclassified native errors remain delivery_unknown.
Existing shared writer/lifecycle locks may return contention; do not create a replacement UUID after uncertain admission.
unchanged: Existing receipts/history retain their original domains.
No session creation, interruption, cancellation, force, credential or security expansion.

tests.command: scripts/check.sh; after correcting the version-schema constant, rerun cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings, check_docs.py, check_contract.py, cargo build --locked --release
tests.environment: Isolated Linux check container; Rust 1.95.0, cached locked public Cargo dependencies, no live account homes/provider sockets mounted.
cases: restart before dispatch with legacy UUID conflict
tests.restart_coverage: Durable ledger/binding reopen and persisted crash-boundary fixtures, not killing a production or actual provider process.
tests.existing_coverage: Full suite retains normal message modes, history, recovery, receipt correlation, generations and lock regressions.

deployment.method: Immutable release directory, verified artifact provenance, atomic current link and local popup backend selection.

agent_dm_next_steps: Review schema, fixtures, source and executable hash.
Add an explicitly requested steering mode and exact target/turn/runtime preconditions.
Represent native acceptance separately from execution/reply; do not wait for a steer-correlated reply that this contract cannot provide.
Retain UUID and uncertainty across retries/restarts; never substitute Queue or repeat unknown steering.
Integrate, pin and deploy independently after review.

notification.authorized: One ordinary Queue completion notification to Agent DM; no steering notification or autonomous follow-up loop.
notification.evidence: Receipt and request are retained outside this public repository.
